shows.description: Shows with missing episodes (season lists without episode titles).

truncated.description: The library had more titles than one overview checks.

withoutTmdb.description: Titles without a TMDB ID, which cannot be compared.

LibrarySceneIndexStatus.description: Result of queueing scene indexing for a library.

pendingItems.description: Movies and episodes that have no indexed scenes yet.

currentSubtitleCue.description: Subtitle line on screen at the current position.

dialogueStreamIndex.description: Subtitle stream the dialogue comes from.

frames.description: Whether (and how often) a screenshot of the scene may be fetched.

recentDialogue.description: Up to the last six lines from the previous 90 seconds, oldest first. Never later lines.

oneOf.description: What is on screen, analysed on the server (the picture does not leave it).

accessEndsAt.description: Hard programme boundary for an age-limited profile; select a channel again afterwards.

hostnames.description: DNS names and/or IP addresses the certificate must be valid for.

startMs.description: Start time in milliseconds; absent for unsynced lyrics.

synced.description: True when every line has a `startMs` (LRC timestamps were present).

MaintenanceReport.description: What a run did, or would do in a preview.

backup.description: File name of the backup made (or that would be made).

cleaned.description: Whether titles were removed in this run.

emptyItems.description: Seasons, shows, albums and artists with nothing left in them.

examples.description: Up to ten of the titles that are (or would be) removed.

goneItems.description: Titles whose files have all been missing longer than `goneDays`.

unreachableLibraries.description: Libraries left alone because their folders could not be read.

unusedBytes.description: Unused space in the database file before the run.

cleanupAfterDays.description: Remove titles whose files have been gone this many days; 0 never removes automatically.

keepBackups.description: Automatic backups to keep; 0 makes none.

utcOffsetMinutes.description: The viewer's offset from UTC in minutes, so `hour` means their local time.

MatchmakerGuestJoined.description: Handed out once when a guest joins. The token identifies the guest from then on.

MatchmakerGuestLink.description: The link code guests use to join a movie night.

MatchmakerGuestTitle.description: A title as a guest sees it.

MatchmakerGuestView.description: What a guest needs to vote: the titles (in the host's order before shuffling) and the result.

seed.description: Seed for the shared shuffle, the same for everyone in the movie night.

status.description: `active`, `matched` or `closed` (planned time passed and no one liked anything).

memberCount.description: People who have joined, including the creator and guests.

startsAt.description: Planned start: voting closes then and the most liked title wins.

McpConfigSnippets.description: Ready-to-copy configuration snippets for popular AI agents and IDEs.

McpPreset.description: Preset permission bundle for the Token Wizard.

McpSnippetsRequest.description: Request to generate client configuration snippets for connecting an AI agent.

McpStatus.description: Administrative status and toggle for the MCP subsystem.

musicbrainzId.description: MusicBrainz ID of the artist or release group (music requests).

MissingMovie.description: A released movie from a collection that the library lacks.

whole.description: No episode of this season is in the library.

MusicSearchHit.description: An artist or album found through Lidarr, ready to be requested.

Network.description: Network classification of the playback session.

NetworkClass.description: The network environment from which a request originated.

NextEpisode.description: The episode to play from a show or season page, with where to start.

startMs.description: Saved position to resume from, 0 to start from the beginning.

NodeCapabilities.description: Node capabilities reported during pairing and health checks.

NodeCatalogSyncRequest.description: Delta catalog synchronization request from a storage node.

NodeCatalogSyncResponse.description: Catalog sync response returned by central server.

needProbe.description: New or changed files the node should probe and upload (bounded; sync again for more).

NodeFileEntry.description: One media file on a node, by path relative to its library root (`/` separated).

NodeFileRef.description: A file the server wants probe data for.

NodeHandoverResponse.description: Smart handover response for direct playback or relay.

NodeLibrary.description: Single library summary exported by a storage node.

files.description:
Complete file listing of the library. When present the server mirrors it as a regular
MBL library; when absent only the summary is stored.

streamSecret.description: Key the node uses to verify the server's signed file URLs. Absent from servers before 1.3.9.

NodeProbeUpload.description: Probe upload for files the server asked for.

NodeProbedFile.description: FFprobe result for one node file (`probe` is MBL's `MediaInfo` JSON).

NpuActivity.description:
What MBL does with the NPU, for the Hardware page: whether it may use it, what is loaded,
how often each model ran in this run of the server and the last problem.

lastUsedAt.description: Unix ms of the last use of any model.

NpuProfile.description: Detected Neural Processing Unit (NPU) accelerator profile (M4.1, M4.17).

OpenSubtitlesSettings.description: OpenSubtitles settings as shown to an admin; the key and password are never returned.

items.description: Compact item for grids and rows.

PlatformProfile.description: Hardware platform class used to pick defaults and hardware transcode pipelines (M4.1).

PlayMethod.description: Overall delivery method chosen by the decision engine.

PlaybackAudioTrack.description: Audio streams available in the selected media version.

PlaybackMarker.description: Timeline marker (intro, credits, chapter) returned in [`PlaybackResponse`].

PlaybackProfileInput.description:
Flexible device profile input accepted by `POST /api/v1/playback`:
- a built-in profile name (`"chrome"`, `"firefox"`, `"safari"`, `"edge"`, `"generic-hls"`),
- a full [`DeviceProfile`] object, or
- a [`DeviceProfileOverlay`] merged onto a named built-in profile.

subtitleStreamIndex.description:
Subtitle stream the client is showing as a text track, if any. Watch companions read
dialogue from this track; without it they fall back to the default subtitle track.

audioOffsetMs.description:
Positive delays audio; negative advances audio (−10000..10000 ms).
Encodes audio; ignored for media with no audio stream.

waitForReady.description:
Wait for readable source / first complete HLS media before acknowledging startup.
Opt-in for existing API clients; enabled by the web player for atomic stream changes.

hasVideo.description: Whether the negotiated source has a real video stream (cover art does not count).

hlsGeneratedTimeline.description:
Actual growing muxer timeline. Prepare a new playback request before seeking
beyond its indexed prefix; absent for direct play and fixed-grid sessions.

PlaybackSubtitleOption.description: Selectable subtitles, including image tracks requiring a new encoded video stream.

PlexImportItem.description: An item exported from Plex or retrieved via Plex token.

PlexImportRequest.description: Request payload containing Plex history items.

ProgressSyncEntry.description: One offline progress entry recorded by a client while disconnected.

played.description: `true` = watched, `false` = explicitly unwatched, absent = resume position.

positionMs.description: Playback position in milliseconds; ignored when `played` is set.

updatedAt.description: Client wall-clock time of the change (Unix epoch milliseconds).

QuickConnectAuthorizeRequest.description: Request from an authenticated user's phone/browser to authorize a 6-digit TV code (M5.8).

QuickConnectInitRequest.description: Request to initiate a Quick-Connect 6-digit login code for `mbl-tv` (M5.8).

QuickConnectPending.description: A device waiting for approval behind a Quick-Connect code.

QuickConnectPollRequest.description: Request from the TV client polling whether its Quick-Connect secret has been authorized (M5.8).

ReachabilityReport.description: Outcome of the CGNAT and external reachability inspection.

checks.description: Individual checks run by the server (public address, router, DNS, port, certificate).

httpsPort.description: HTTPS port the server listens on, when HTTPS is enabled.

publicHostnames.description: Public host names configured for the server (certificate names and `public_url`).

canDelete.description: Whether this caller may cancel/delete the recording.

oneOf.description: Ordinary library item, available only after the recorded file has been probed.

RecordingPlan.description: Read-only normalization and admission snapshot; it does not reserve a tuner or create a library.

RecordingRecoveryPlan.description: Read-only file and storage check; recoverable bytes are not yet proof of playable media.

cleanup.description: Also remove titles whose files are gone (and empty seasons/shows).

dryRun.description: Report what would happen without changing anything.

SceneAnalysis.description:
What is on screen, as text: from the NPU when there is one (objects, people, a description),
otherwise a rough guess from colours that is marked as such.

backend.description: `cpu-heuristic`, or the NPU model that looked at the frame.

colourGuess.description: Rough impressions from the colours (`night`, `snow`…); a guess even with an NPU.

description.description: A sentence from a vision-language model, when one is installed.

npu.description: True when an NPU analysed the frame; false for the colour guess.

objects.description: What the NPU detected, with counts (`2 person`, `cup`). Empty without an NPU.

positionMs.description: Position of the analysed frame (never later than the viewer's).

SceneHintInput.description: Input scene hint for indexing keyframes on an item (M5.13).

SceneSearchHit.description: Semantic scene search match returned by `GET /api/v1/ai/search-scenes` (M5.13).

oneOf.description: Retry this owned failed/partial recording, preserving its owner and surviving series rule.

replyTo.description: ID of the viewer message this answers. Required while the viewer allows replies only.

ServerEndpoints.description: Addresses a client may use to reach this server, plus the local CA fingerprint for pinning.

caSha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the MBL Local CA certificate (DER), if one exists.

httpsPort.description: HTTPS listener port when TLS is enabled.

publicUrl.description: Configured externally reachable URL, if any.

tailnetUrls.description: MagicDNS and tailnet IP URLs when Tailscale is running.

serverId.description: Stable random identifier of this server installation (persisted in settings).

license.description: The voice's license, with the credit CC BY asks for.

pin.description: 4-8 numeric digits, or null to remove PIN.

serverRecognition.description: The server can turn speech into text (Whisper on the NPU).

serverVoices.description: Languages the server can read aloud (Piper voices installed).

StreamAction.description: Action to take for an individual video or audio stream.

SubtitleDelivery.description: How subtitles will be delivered for the session.

SubtitleMethod.description: How a subtitle format can be delivered to the client.

SubtitleRule.description: Delivery rule for one subtitle codec/format.

SubtitleSearchStatus.description: Whether subtitle search is set up.

matchSpeech.description:
Move subtitles to where people speak in the audio, for files timed for another cut or
frame rate. Default off.

pin.description: Required when the profile has a PIN.

SystemHealthReport.description: System health snapshot including thermal/power monitoring and platform defaults (M5.1, M5.2).

dlnaEnabled.description: Off until an admin turns it on; DLNA has no sign-in.

dlnaLibraryIds.description: Libraries shared over DLNA. Nothing is shared while this is empty.

dlnaMaxRating.description: Highest content rating shared over DLNA (for example `PG-13`); none means no limit.

TailscalePeer.description: A peer on the tailnet and whether the connection is direct or relayed.

TailscaleStatus.description: Current status of the Tailscale node on the host.

TailscaleWhois.description: Resolved identity of a tailnet caller from LocalAPI `whois`.

TestArrConnection.description: Connection test input. Without `apiKey` the stored key is used.

ThermalStatus.description: Snapshot of host thermal and power status.

idleJobsPaused.description: Whether background idle jobs (`Priority::Idle`) are paused due to high temperature (≥ 75 °C) or active throttling.

rawThrottled.description: Raw Raspberry Pi `get_throttled` bitmask, if available.

temperatureC.description: Current SoC / CPU temperature in degrees Celsius, if readable.

throttlingOccurred.description: Thermal throttling has occurred since last boot (`bit 18` or `bit 19`).

underVoltageOccurred.description: Under-voltage has occurred since last boot (`bit 16`).

acmeEmail.description: Configured Let's Encrypt contact email (if any).

caAvailable.description: The local root CA exists and can be downloaded for installation on devices.

enabled.description: Serve HTTPS when a certificate is available.

listenerError.description: Why the HTTPS listener is not serving the configured certificate and port, if it is not.

uri.description: `otpauth://` URI ready for QR code generation.

TranscodeCapacity.description: Live transcode capacity summary derived from hardware profile, self-test FPS, and active sessions (M4.11).

TranscodeTarget.description: Target HLS container and ordered codec preferences used for remux and transcoding.

apiKey.description: New key; omit or leave empty to keep the stored one.

metadataProfileId.description: Lidarr only: which releases (albums, singles, EPs…) an added artist gets.

apiKey.description: New key; omit or leave empty to keep the stored one.

clearApiKey.description: Remove the stored key (for local servers that need none).

UpdateCheckResponse.description: Information about the latest available MBL server release on GitHub.

assetName.description: Filename of the recommended asset (e.g. .msi on Windows, .deb on Debian/Pi).

checkedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the check was performed.

downloadUrl.description: Direct download URL for the recommended binary/installer for this platform.

error.description: Error message if reaching GitHub or checking updates failed.

htmlUrl.description: Link to the release page on GitHub.

latestVersion.description: Latest release version tag on GitHub.

publishedAt.description: Timestamp when this release was published on GitHub.

updateAvailable.description: True if GitHub has a newer version than currently running.

UpdateItemMetadata.description:
Fields to change. Every field sent is stored and locked; an empty string clears an
optional field. `lockedFields`, when sent, replaces the lock list before that.

UpdateMcpStatusRequest.description: Request payload to update MCP status (e.g. kill-switch toggle).

apiKey.description: New API key; leave out to keep the stored one.

clear.description: Remove the stored key, username and password.

password.description: New password; leave out to keep the stored one.

dlnaLibraryIds.description:
Replaces the shared libraries; `dlnaMaxRating` is stored together with it (absent or
empty clears the limit).

hiddenHubs.description: Hub keys hidden by the user on the Home screen.

hiddenNav.description: Menu entries the user has hidden.

navOrder.description:
Menu entries (their paths, e.g. `"/livetv"`) in the user's order; entries missing
here keep their default place after the ordered ones.

isManaged.description: Managed profiles can be entered with their PIN; other accounts need their password.

UserSecurityInfo.description: Security and access profile for a user.

status.description: HTTP status returned by the receiver, when it answered.

WorkerBatchEstimate.description: Batch offload estimation returned for dry-run optimization requests.

WorkerCapabilities.description: Worker hardware capabilities reported during pairing and health checks.

WorkerEncoder.description: One working encoder on a worker, proven by the worker's own FFmpeg self-test.

WorkerHeartbeat.description: Heartbeat message sent periodically by workers.

WorkerJob.description:
A transcode assignment. The server never sends command lines: `pipeline` is the server's
typed transcode model (`mbl_transcode::Pipeline`), which the worker turns into FFmpeg arguments
itself after replacing the input with `sourcePath` and the output with a local directory.

renditions.description: Rendition directory names; uploads go to `/api/v1/workers/jobs/{jobId}/files/{rendition}/{file}`.

WorkerJobOutcome.description: Final outcome of a job reported by the worker.

message.description: Short reason for a failure (FFmpeg's last error lines), never shown to end users verbatim.

WorkerMessage.description: Instruction delivered to a worker in a poll response.

WorkerPathMapping.description: Path mapping allowing workers to read shared network media directly.

WorkerPollRequest.description: Long-poll request: the worker reports what it can run right now and waits for work.

activeJobIds.description: Jobs the worker is still running; anything else the server believes is running has failed.

paused.description: True while the host is busy with something else (for example a game) and must not get new jobs.

WorkerPollResponse.description: Poll response; an empty list means the wait timed out and the worker should poll again.
